evidence.title: Reicon — Free Open-Source Icon Library for Designers & Developers | Parascope

name: Reicon
summary: Free MIT-licensed icon library with 2,700+ hand-drawn SVG icons on a 24×24 grid, in outline and fill styles.
description: Reicon is a free, open-source library of more than 2,700 SVG icons, all hand-designed and reviewed on a 24×24 pixel grid rather than auto-traced. Outline and fill styles ship as packages for React, Vue and Svelte with CDN support, plus a playground for color, size and stroke width; it is dependency-free, tree-shakeable and MIT-licensed for personal and commercial use.
contains: 2,700+ hand-designed SVG icons on a 24×24 grid
packages for React, Vue and Svelte, plus CDN loading
playground for color, size and stroke width
MIT licensed, free for personal and commercial use
